description: Pack a primary GLB plus sidecar files (textures/, etc.) into a single `.glb.zip` archive with a versioned manifest. Sidecar paths inside the archive default to their basenames; pass `sidecar_arcnames` to override. Auto-DEFLATE per entry, falling back to stored when DEFLATE wastes bytes. Returns the manifest and on-disk size.

primary_arcname.description: Filename for the primary GLB inside the bundle (default: basename of primary_path).

primary_path.description: Sandbox-relative path to the primary GLB.

sidecar_arcnames.description: Optional override for sidecar relative paths inside the archive. Must match sidecar_paths length and order. Defaults to sidecar basenames.

sidecar_paths.description: Sandbox-relative paths to sidecar files (textures, sounds, etc.).

name: bundle_glb_zip
title: Bundle a GLB + sidecars into a single .glb.zip (SPEC-0091)
